## Testing

- [ ] Ran on Android through Expo Go
- [ ] Ran on iPhone through Expo Go
- [ ] Ran `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Ran `npm run lint`
- [ ] Added or updated tests where appropriate

## React Native review checklist

- [ ] Components avoid unnecessary re-renders
- [ ] `useMemo` / `useCallback` are used only where they provide value
- [ ] Hooks have correct dependency arrays
- [ ] Screens are accessible and readable on small devices
- [ ] Navigation params are typed
- [ ] No diagnosis/medical claims are introduced
- [ ] Screening language remains educational and disclaimer-based
